summary: Report GitHub required-check transitions for the current ready workflow execution.

replay.detail: No graph projection, replay or repair changes.

schema.detail: No SQL schema or migration changes.

compatibility.detail: GitHub observations add workflow execution identity to required_checks facts. Latest workflow suites supersede older contexts; pre-ready pull-request skips stay pending, while current conditional skips still satisfy checks. Terminal notifications can fire for a new execution on the same head without an observed pending transition. Partial suite/check pages cannot qualify success. Existing watches and commit-status semantics are retained.

downtime.detail: Selecting this watcher implementation requires the ordinary daemon rollout; restart interruption is unmeasured.

manual.detail: No watch re-registration or CI rerun is required. Curator eligibility still requires its own exact-head review and current check evidence.

recovery.detail: No durable migration is introduced. Rolling back restores the older watcher interpretation and notification limits.
